title: Lp Developer Build Section Output
description: Output of the *build-section task (Stack). Each section as production-ready code.

builtSections.description: Each landing page section built as semantic HTML (section with id + aria-labelledby, correct heading hierarchy, descriptive alt text, labeled forms) styled from the design-system CSS tokens (zero hardcoded hex/px/font), responsive mobile-first across the breakpoints, with scroll-triggered animations guarded by prefers-reduced-motion. Integrates Quill's copy and Lens's images faithfully. WCAG AA contrast and 44x44px touch targets verified.
